environment.rmw: rmw_fastrtps_cpp only; no alternate RMW installed

payload_precondition: Every DAVE-sonar active-launch run reached backend-ready and captured populated 513x301 PointCloud2 plus 513x399 raw sonar before teardown. Stock controls separately captured their declared payloads except one camera ROS-discovery miss; all stock bridge shutdowns were clean.
gdb_observation: Under GDB, SIGSEGV occurs on Fast DDS-named threads such as dds.ev.0 or dds.udp.* while the main thread is in process finalization (_dl_fini) and libtracetools.so destructor/dlclose. Explicit TRACETOOLS_RUNTIME_DISABLE=1 printed ROS 2 tracing disabled but still crashed 8/10, so tracing disable is not a fix and the backtrace must not be treated as proof that tracetools owns the root cause.
verdict: Reproducible DAVE-sonar-associated active-endpoint teardown defect. No-active-publisher controls are 40/40 clean; stock camera and GPU-lidar controls, including a 513x301 lidar, are 30/30 clean at bridge shutdown. DAVE sonar still crashes with a point-cloud-only bridge (2/10). Direction, signal, tracing disable, ordered waits, and explicit node reset plus rclcpp shutdown do not eliminate it. Runtime payload delivery succeeds before shutdown.
